data.name: HelpContent
data.value:
Backup location Choose a separate cloud folder per project, or enter a path relative to OneDrive root, such as Projects/DROP_CODE. Original file names and subdirectories are used directly. The HarborBackup management folder contains metadata, archives and conflicts only. Other devices use the same management folder and project target through the authorized account.
Comparison and conflicts Cloud comparisons use metadata, item identities, version tags and checksums without downloading file contents. Files without trusted metadata are skipped by normal backup and pull. Use More actions > Retrieve and establish baseline to review them separately. Only checked preview items run, and changed versions are skipped. Retrieve cloud project selects a cloud project and this PC's folder, then adds the mapping and retrieves files after preview confirmation. Divergent edits keep both versions for explicit resolution. Backup does not change the source; Pull does not change cloud file contents. Deletions are not propagated.
History Only the previous ordinary version is retained. Older history is removed after a verified commit. Unresolved conflicts and unfinished recovery evidence are excluded from this cleanup. Online-only protection does not download copies; Keep local does.
Scheduling and cache Repeated triggers are skipped while a run is active. Startup delay and run time limit are configurable. Stop finishes at a safe boundary. Local hash cache uses size and UTC modification time. Full checks hash local content only; cloud comparisons still read metadata only.
Configuration and logs Built-in global rules are unchecked by default and combine with global custom and project exclusions. Patterns are shown next to each option. File name patterns match at any depth, ignoring case. Word pattern ~$*.docx does not match ~plan.docx; enter ~*.docx manually for a broader match. Unchecking a preset preserves matching manual rules. Exclusions do not delete existing files, history or recovery evidence. Save edited settings; account and login startup settings apply separately. Language is device-local. Log and history retention affect diagnostics and displayed records, not backup contents. Open logs from Run history. JSON configuration shortcuts are at the bottom of Settings. Closing the window leaves the tray running. Exiting stops this device's scheduled backups.
